result.question: What happens to Jeroboam's hand?

readings.support: the hand he stretched out toward him withered
so that he could not pull it back

assessments.reason: The text says “the hand he stretched out toward him withered,” which is equivalent in meaning to “dried up.”
The passage adds “so that he could not pull it back,” which is a stated consequence for his hand even if it is not the same description as “dried up.”

result.reason: The passage adds “so that he could not pull it back,” which is a stated consequence for his hand even if it is not the same description as “dried up.”
